space-1.$description: Gap between a marker dot and its label.

space-2.$description: Inside chips and between stacked list items.

space-3.$description: Button padding, gap between a heading and its eyebrow.

space-4.$description: Gap between a heading and its paragraph.

space-5.$description: Card padding and grid gutters on mobile.

space-6.$description: Card padding on desktop, gap between cards.

space-7.$description: Gap between a section header and its content.

space-8.$description: Section padding on mobile, page side margin on desktop.

space-9.$description: Section padding on desktop. This spacing is what makes the page feel calm.

radius-xs.$description: Marker dots and tiny UI squares.

radius-sm.$description: Small controls inside product illustrations. Not buttons or tabs, which use radius-md. Chips and tags use 6px.

radius-xl.$description: Screenshot frames and large feature blocks.

radius-pill.$description: Avatars and status dots only. Not buttons or tabs.

radius-card.$description: Section cards on the grey page.
